rows.jyutping: zoeng1 A zeoi6 maai4 jat1 cai4
rows.note: Use this causative pattern when bringing people or things together in one place.

example.english: I congregate the documents in one folder so everyone can read them easily.
example.traditional: 將啲文件聚埋一齊，方便大家睇。
example.jyutping: zoeng1 di1 man4 gin6 zeoi6 maai4 jat1 cai4 fong1 bin6 daai6 gaa1 tai2

rows.note: This is the casual default when people come together themselves.

example.english: We congregate for dinner after work quite often.
example.traditional: 我哋放工後成日聚埋一齊食飯。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 fong3 gung1 hau6 sing4 jat6 zeoi6 maai4 jat1 cai4 sik6 faan6

rows.note: Use this for an organized or instructed assembly rather than an informal gathering.

example.english: When you hear the bell, congregate and don’t wander off.
example.traditional: 聽到鐘聲就集合，唔好周圍走。
example.jyutping: teng1 dou3 zung1 seng1 zau6 zaap6 hap6 m4 hou2 zau1 wai4 zau2
